claim.claim-text: a filter housing (2); a first filter (3); and a second filter (4), wherein the first filter (3) is a pre-motor filter, and the second filter (4) is a post-motor filter, and both the first and second filters are fixed to the filter housing and are annular about a common axis, wherein the flow direction for the first filter is opposite to the flow direction for the second filter, and the flow direction for the first filter is radially inwards towards the common axis (A), and the flow direction for the second filter is radially outwards away from the common axis.
2. A filter assembly as claimed in claim 1, wherein the cross-sectional shape of one or both of the first and second filters is one of circular, elliptical or obround.
3. A filter assembly as claimed in claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the first filter is adjacent the second filter in a direction along the common axis.
4. A filter assembly as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the filter housing comprises an exposed portion and an enclosed portion.

5. A filter assembly as claimed in claim 4, wherein the exposed portion of the filter housing comprises a frame (5) extending from the enclosed portion, the first filter being positioned around the frame.
6. A filter assembly as claimed in claim 4 or claim 5, wherein the enclosed portion of the filter housing comprises an outer casing (6), and the second filter is positioned inside the outer casing.
7. A filter assembly as claimed in claim 6, wherein the outer casing has vent holes (7).
8. A filter assembly as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first filter comprises a layered filter medium.
9. A filter assembly as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the second filter is a pleated filter.
10. A filter assembly as claimed in any one of the preceding claims wherein the filter housing comprises an annular seal between the first and second filters.
a motor (26); and the filter assembly of any one of the previous claims, wherein the filter assembly at least partially overlaps with the motor in a direction along the common axis.

12. A vacuum cleaner as claimed in claim 11, wherein the filter assembly is positioned around the motor such that the first filter is positioned around an inlet to the motor, and the second filter is positioned around an outlet of the motor.

13. A vacuum cleaner as claimed in claim 12, wherein the motor is housed in a cylindrical motor bucket (20) having a motor bucket inlet (21) and a motor bucket outlet (23), the filter assembly is positioned around the motor bucket and is removable from the vacuum cleaner by sliding the filter assembly over the motor bucket along the direction of the common axis.

14. A vacuum cleaner as claimed in claim 13, wherein the motor bucket inlet comprises a plurality of through-holes (22) aligned with the inlet (27) of the motor, and the motor bucket outlet comprises a plurality of through-holes aligned with the outlet of the motor.

15. A vacuum cleaner as claimed in claim 13 or 14, wherein the filter housing comprises an annular seal between the first and second filters, and the annular seal is in sealing contact with a solid central portion of the motor bucket between the motor bucket inlet and motor bucket outlet.
